style.styleTitle: Family of Deer Personalised Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised glass bauble containing a family of deer to represent your family. The deer are made from wood and printed with an illustrated design to give each character personality. With a choice of 4 character styles to perfectly match your family members, each deer is also printed with a name and the bauble is finished with an engraved star charm that can be personalised with a line of text such as “Family Christmas”. The bauble measures 10x10cm.
